{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999999.99'
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check their status
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Status of QA orders: {qa_orders["status"].value_counts().to_dict()}')

# Filter out QA orders from the dataset
valid_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Count completed orders among valid ones
completed_valid = valid_orders[valid_orders['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Also count refunded for verification
refunded_valid = valid_orders[valid_orders['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

# Print results
print(f'Completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_valid}')
print(f'Refunded orders (excluding QA): {refunded_valid}')
print(f'Total valid orders: {len(valid_orders)}')"}
